business_summary.text: Vedanta Oil & Gas Limited (formerly Malco Energy Limited) is an oil and gas exploration and production company with assets in Rajasthan, offshore India and OALP blocks.

call_points.text: FY27 direct operating cost expected in line with FY26 levels.
Unit operating cost fell 3% QoQ to $17.4/bbl on workover and well intervention efficiencies.
Gross operated production averaged 77.7 kboepd, with Rajasthan at 63.1 kboepd.
Assigned AA+ stable long-term rating by both CRISIL and ICRA.
Exceptional costs of ₹345 Cr net of tax for impairment and one-off items.
Discontinued operations contributed a one-time ₹1,097 Cr profit from the Malco undertaking transfer.
About 85% of volumes were sold in the quarter; the balance is expected to liquidate post-monsoon.

guidance.statement: FY27 direct operating cost expected in line with FY26 levels

industry: Energy > Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels > Oil > Oil Exploration & Production

operating_notes.text: Gross operated production averaged 77.7 kboepd in Q1FY27, down 17% YoY from 93.2 kboepd.
Unit operating cost was $17.4/bbl in Q1FY27, down 3% QoQ.
Average oil price realisation was $99.7/bbl in Q1FY27 versus $65.6/bbl a year ago.

events.lender: GLAS Agency (Hong Kong) Limited, acting for the benefit of the Lenders under the Facility Agreement

timeline.summary: Vedanta Oil & Gas reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹2,507 Cr (down 3% QoQ) and EBITDA of ₹1,232 Cr (up 16% QoQ), with a ₹345 Cr exceptional charge driving a ₹152 Cr loss from continuing operations and reported PAT of ₹945 Cr including discontinued operations.
All 10 resolutions were approved by members on October 26, 2026, with voting results and Scrutinizer’s Report filed on October 27, 2026.
